presence_analysis.mysql_deduplication_mechanism: Table physical_dataset_collection enforces UNIQUE KEY (participant_id, hand, finger, `condition`). When metadata was synced to MySQL using INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, the later entries (lines 7 and 8) updated the previous entries (lines 3 and 2) rather than creating new rows. Thus, MySQL contains exactly 4 records for participant Kusuma with 0 duplicates.

case_mismatch_detail.os_behavior: Windows NTFS is case-preserving but case-insensitive, allowing resolution, but Linux/strict systems will treat this as a mismatch.

discrepancy_reconciliation_88_vs_86_vs_8.summary: The +4 discrepancy between 88 metadata rows and 84 physical images consists of exactly 2 re-capture duplicates (Kusuma) plus 2 orphan/ghost records without image files (ashitta).

breakdown.details: 21 verified participants * 4 captures (Right Clean, Right Distorted, Left Clean, Left Distorted) = 42 clean + 42 distorted.
Lines 2 and 3 recorded initial clean captures. Lines 7 and 8 recorded re-captures 23 minutes later, which overwrote the physical images on disk but appended new rows in CSV.

Lines 36 and 37 recorded clean captures for participant ashitta, but corresponding image files clean/ashitta_RIGHT_THUMB_clean.png and clean/ashitta_LEFT_THUMB_clean.png do not exist on disk. Ashitta also has 0 distorted captures and is not present in gallery_manifest.csv.

reconciliation_equation.csv_total: 84 physical + 2 Kusuma duplicates + 2 ashitta ghost = 88 rows
reconciliation_equation.mysql_total: 84 physical + 0 Kusuma duplicates (deduped by UNIQUE key) + 2 ashitta ghost = 86 rows

recommended_corrections.details: Safely remove obsolete CSV lines 2 and 3 (timestamps 11:47:50 and 11:54:09), retaining lines 7 and 8 which match the physical disk files.
Either capture the missing physical fingerprints for participant ashitta (2 clean + 2 distorted) to make the participant complete, or archive lines 36 and 37 to a separate quarantine file.

recommended_corrections.action: Harmonize participant ID casing for Bharthi
recommended_corrections.details: Normalize line 27 participant_id from 'BHarthi' to 'Bharthi' to eliminate case mismatch.
After performing approved CSV adjustments, re-run sync to maintain exact 1-to-1 parity across Disk, CSV, and MySQL.
